items.b: CHOW TAI FOOK FILES TO REGISTER UP TO RMB 10 BILLION OF PANDA BONDS
items.t: Chow Tai Fook Jewellery Group has applied to register up to RMB 10 billion of debt financing instruments with China's interbank market dealers' association, to be issued in tranches within two years of acceptance.

items.b: MORPHY ESTIMATES AN OSCAR HEYMAN NECKLACE AT 40.3% OF ITS 2014 INVOICE
items.t: A $150,000 to $250,000 estimate against the $620,000 invoice in the lot's own box, in a 357-lot sale at Denver, Pennsylvania on 24 September.

items.b: ROLEX HOLDS ABOUT 31% OF CHRONO24 DOLLAR SALES, OMEGA ABOUT 11%
items.t: Buyers under 30 have cut the share of their spending devoted to Rolex by about 30% since 2022, on the marketplace's own research.

items.b: PALLADIUM SHEDS $97 TO $1,280 SINCE THE 7 SEPTEMBER MARK
items.t: Gold, silver and platinum each lost between 1.27% and 1.87% over the same four sessions on Kitco's bid.

tape_ts: 12 Sep 2026 - Kitco's bid, re-read by the Editor at press time and unchanged from the 05:00 tape, so the 05:00 marks stand and print here: gold 4,347.70, silver 64.372, platinum 1,792.00, palladium 1,280.00. The board carries its own 17:00 timestamp of 11 September on all four metals, which is the last print of the week; changes shown are against the 11 September morning mark in Carat Capital's own record, not Kitco's change field.
